parsed.why: Transition itself criminalised under Art. 390 (5-10 yrs), organisations banned, coordinated arrests and imprisonment of dozens, HIV services collapsed, asylum seekers refused and attacked. Severe criminal exposure for any outed trans traveller; no protections operate.

Enforced criminal regime with doubled maximum (5-10 yrs), arrests on second-hand reports, documented custody torture and mob desecration of a man outed as gay. Trans-specific content thin, but structural signals and documented violence put it in high-risk territory.

Statute (14 yrs) is unenforced with no recorded prosecutions in recent years and no trans-specific abuse documented. Thin trans data, no recognition or protection; official rhetoric hostile. Structural signals keep it moderately low, not midpoint-safe.

Self-declaration, marriage equality, conversion-practice ban and rising hate incidents with a 17% survey prevalence of threats and 8% physical violence. Police say undercounted; no evident state targeting; protections on paper plus a worsening street climate.

No criminalisation, but documented societal hostility, a violent first-Pride attack, and official hostility from a mayor. Passport gender-marker recognition is blocked and the civil-registry chapter withdrawn, so outed visitors face document friction. Some court and prosecution function.
